sections.Profile:
Thanos has summoned the Black Order in an attempt to finally take down the Avengers, and the heroes must reclaim the stolen Infinity Stones to save the world, traveling back in time through Doctor Strange's portal to battle the Black Order. Keith Elwin's design opens those portals with a spinning Doctor Strange sling ring disc on the playfield.
